newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO CETES RATE REVERSES RISE ON LATE BUYING.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO CETES RATE REVERSES RISE ON LATE BUYING.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates reversed an earlier sharp rise on last-minute buying, dealers said.
"Rates shot up on a weak peso and the long bond, but players bought at the close because none wanted to go liquid into the weekend," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso closed 0.75 centavo weaker at 7.8150/7.8200 per dollar, while U.S. 30-year Treasury bonds were down 1-14/32 in late dealing to yield 6.64 percent.
Dealers said central bank intervention also exerted upside pressure on market rates.
